newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU Parliament condemns Taliban treatment of women.
newsitem.headline: EU Parliament condemns Taliban treatment of women.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday condemned what it said was systematic discrimination against women by Afghanistan's purist Islamic Taleban.

In a resolution, the 626-member assembly said the Taleban were excluding women from work and education, ordering them to be completely veiled in public and reducing their freedom of movement to a minimum.

It urged the European Union and other international aid donors to "refrain from any new aid or cooperation programmes, except emergency aid, until the human rights of men and women are respected by the administration."
The parliament reiterated its demand for an arms embargo which should in addition cover all related military equipment.
The Taleban movement, founded by religious students, captured the Afghan capital Kabul on September 27.
